svg.title: Agentic Chip Design — project ecosystem
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the selected layered project and ecosystem concept illustration. User applications connect to ChipContext, AgentLoop, PyCircuit and knowledge, supported by runtimes, tools and design evaluation. svg.text: Bridge AI and Chip Design — Let Agents Design, Reason and Optimize with Real Engineering Context.
Open Design. Smarter Chips. A More Capable Future.
